newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI Australia, ICI reach agreement.
newsitem.headline: ICI Australia, ICI reach agreement.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said it had entered into agreements to govern its relationship with Imperial Chemical Industries Plc after ICI Plc sells down its 62.4 percent stake in the Australian group.
The documents relate to intellectual property, technology, supply and distribution arrangements, ICI Australia said.

Since ICI Plc announced on May 7 that it intended to sell its shareholding in ICI Australia, discussions have taken place between the management of the two companies about the commercial relationship which will exist between them after the sell-down, the company said.

The discussions have now been completed and the companies have entered into a range of transitional arrangements and continuing commercial agreements to govern the relationship after the sell-down, ICI Australia said.

"Signing of these agreements means that the first stepping stone is in place for ICI Australia's future as an independent company," ICI Australia executive director Philip Weickhardt said in a statement.
"We are also satisfied that, with the exception of some one-off separation costs the ongoing commercial and technology agreements will be neutral to positive for ICI Australia ..."
Concerning technology, Weickhardt added: "We are confident that we have the technology base to enable us to develop our business successfully in the future".
Key features of the agreements include:
- The agreements come into effect from the date upon which ICI Plc's shareholding in ICI Australia falls below 50 percent.

- ICI Australia retains exclusive rights to use the ICI roundel and the ICI house mark in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea for one year. A further announcement will be made concerning a change in the group's name.

- ICI Australia owns the key brands in the paint business in Australia and New Zealand including the "Dulux" brand. ICI Australia will be able to exploit opportunities in paint markets internationally, particularly in Asia.
In auto refinish and can coating ICI Australia and ICI Plc have entered into a seven year agreement to maintain existing co-operative arrangements.

- The arrangements between the companies on explosives will assist ICI Australia to continue to operate its explosives business in Australia and New Zealand and will provide the company with enhanced opportunities in Asia.
- ICI Australia will continue to export surfactant products to Asia through ICI Plc companies for a 12 month period.
- For a period of three years ICI Australia will continue to act as ICI Plc's distributor for the majority of its resale products in Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea and Fiji.
